thread:
maria: Quick preflight — finalizing invite segmentation + demo anchors for Wed webinar. Need decisions on 3 things:
1) product/demo anchor (low-latency routing demo)
2) invite segments for targeted follow-ups
3) rehearsal slots + greenroom leads. 
Can we lock today? :eyes:

oliver: happy to lead the demo if folks agree. can show the routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> pre-record) in ~6 mins.

dan: For segmentation I vote: 1) Startups (self-serve) 2) Platform/PMs (feature-focused) 3) Enterprise (SLA/compliance). Each gets a slightly different CTA + follow-up cadence. I'll map to our SDR queues.

fran: AV/greenroom note — we need a 30m pre-check for the live demo lead. can we do Tue 4pm PT and Wed 9:30am PT? ops-bot: reminder scheduled: Tue 16:00 PT greenroom check + Wed 09:30 PT final tech check.

ash (ash): Demo checklist (short):
```
- demo machine: stable model pinned -> model:v2.1-lowlat
- env: REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxxxxxxx
- run quick latency check: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"latency test"}' | jq .latency
- fallback: ready pre-recorded 90s clip at s3://redwood-webinars/fallback-demo.mp4
```

ash (ash): also suggest we include a 30s synthetic load to show autoscaling/batching behavior. small script attached in the drive.

dan: RSVP numbers — marketing-bot: current counts?

marketing-bot: RSVP update — total 1,240; Startups 540; Platform/PMs 420; Enterprise 280. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (edit = growth+marketing)

oliver: good split. For the demo anchors I propose: 
- Anchor A (2.5 min): sub-second chat reply (low-latency)
- Anchor B (2.5 min): cost vs quality toggle (batching + quantization)
- Anchor C (1.5 min): failover to dedicated region -> pre-record
we can stitch together into a 7–8 min live segment.

maria: love it. Dan — can you map the 3 segments to SDR queues + an email template for each? try to keep templates < 90 words.

dan: on it. will post drafts by EOD.

fran: greenroom roles: oliver (demo lead), maria (moderator), ash (tech standby), fran (AV), dan (QA + follow-up mapping). Anyone else want to be on deck?

oliver: I'll bring the short script + timestamped cue cards. can someone record the pre-recorded fallback and upload to the drive?

ash (ash): uploading fallback now -> s3 link + verified playback.

maria: rehearsal slots — opt-in: Tue 10am PT (walkthrough) & Tue 4pm PT (full run) & Wed 9:30am PT (greenroom). Please RSVP to the calendar invites.

marketing-bot: Calendar invites sent to participants.

maria: last bit — routing for inbound leads: Dan, recommend we create two touchpoints: 1) immediate 1-email tailored by cohort, 2) 3-day follow-up with demo clip + CTA to book Dedicated trial. Keep messaging short and product-focused.

dan: will create the two sequences and link to templates in the sheet.

maria: perfect. action items: oliver -> demo script + cue cards; ash -> upload fallback + test script; dan -> SDR mapping + email templates; fran -> confirm AV kit and greenroom triage; marketing-bot -> finalize RSVP lists. Try to close all by EOD today. :pray:
